subtitle: Run several sub-agents in parallel — each on its own live frame.
watchHint: Watch the live browser the agent is driving.
watchSubtitle: Live view of what the agent is doing on the web.

super.label: Super
super.onHint: Super is ON: the agent can open and operate a live browser for you. Toggle off to chat normally.
super.offHint: Turn Super ON to let the agent open and operate a live browser on your behalf.

super.disabled: Super OFF — the agent will chat normally.

desktopOnly: The Workspace runs sub-agents on native browser views, so it is only available in the desktop app.
bridgeUnavailable: The workspace service is not ready yet. The feature will be available once the desktop bridge is connected.
empty: Type an instruction below — for example "search jobs on glassdoor.com and edit notes.md" — then run it to fan out into parallel frames.

composer.placeholder: Describe what to do. Mention a site (e.g. glassdoor.com) and a file (e.g. notes.md) to run them side by side.
composer.noModels: No models configured. Open Settings → Model.
composer.hint: Tip: mention both a website and a file to launch two sub-agents at once. Press Ctrl/Cmd+Enter to run.
